# Deel — Deel for startups

A 'Startup pricing bundle' with two published components: free U.S. payroll for founders for life, and the first 5 seats free for life for venture-backed startups that have raised at least $500k.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open, but requires a sales conversation |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-14 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [👥 HR & People](../categories/hr.md) |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free U.S. Payroll for Founders | — | U.S. Payroll for founders for life | No partner needed |
| First 5 seats free for life (venture-backed) | — | **Criteria: Must have raised at least $500k in funding (verifiable on Crunchbase) | No partner needed |

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

The two published components carry different gates, so they are recorded as tiers rather than merged. The $500k funding floor and the 'venture-backed' wording attach only to the 5-free-seats component; the free founder U.S. payroll component carries no published funding or backing requirement. Top-level requires_vc_backing and funding_min_usd are therefore left unset/unknown - see tiers. The only CTA on the page is 'Book a demo'; the page does not state that a call is mandatory, so requires_sales_call is unknown. A separate site-wide banner ('Get 3 months free of PEO*') is a general promotion, not part of the startup bundle, and is deliberately not recorded here. Requested URL www.deel.com/startups/ 301s to www.deel.com/segments/startups/.
